tooltip.robotica.codex: Right-click to read. The first page shows your next steps.
codex.robotica.guide.title: Your next steps
codex.robotica.guide.all_done: Every step is done. Robotica is yours.
codex.robotica.guide.missing: The guide steps are missing from this resource pack.
codex.robotica.guide.click: Click an icon for its recipe
advancements.robotica.guide.root.title: Robotica
advancements.robotica.guide.root.descrip: Robots do the boring work for you. Start with copper, wood and cobblestone. Your Codex has the recipes.
Craft a Copper Gear: four copper ingots around a cobblestone.
advancements.robotica.guide.mainspring.d: Put a Mainspring in a Winding Crank, then hold right-click on the crank with an empty hand.
Place Stumpy among trees or Sprout in a field. Put a chest or Supply Crate right next to it.
advancements.robotica.guide.robot_workin: Right-click your robot with the wound Mainspring. It starts working on its own.
advancements.robotica.guide.hammer.title: Hammer Time
advancements.robotica.guide.hammer.descr: Make a Tinker's Hammer. It mines 3x3, and with two ingots in the crafting grid it makes a plate.
advancements.robotica.guide.first_iron.d: Smelt iron. A burner generator, your first battery and power tools are a few ingots away.
advancements.robotica.guide.mining_drone: Craft a Mining Drone. Give it a battery and torches, aim it, and it digs a 3x3 tunnel and brings the loot back.
advancements.robotica.guide.generator.de: Place a Combustion Generator and right-click it with coal or logs. It powers what touches it.
advancements.robotica.guide.charger.desc: Place a Charger touching the generator and right-click it with a cell or a drill.
Craft a Copper Cell. In your inventory it recharges the FE tool in your hand.
advancements.robotica.guide.conduit.desc: Lay Copper Conduits from a generator to your machines. They connect by themselves.
advancements.robotica.guide.power_tool.d: Smithing table: Tool Upgrade Kit I + your hammer + an Electric Motor make a Bore Drill. The felling axe becomes a Chainsaw.
advancements.robotica.guide.basic_circui: Craft a Basic Circuit (it needs gold). Solar, upgrade cards, farm kits and warp pads open up.
advancements.robotica.guide.drones.title: Air Support
advancements.robotica.guide.drones.descr: Craft a Sentry Drone to guard your base, or a Courier Drone to carry items between chests.
Place a Metal Press: one ingot makes one plate, twice what the hammer gives.
advancements.robotica.guide.upgrade_card: Craft an upgrade card and right-click a robot or machine with it. More cards of a kind stack.
advancements.robotica.guide.farm_kit.des: Right-click a placed Stumpy or Sprout with a Farm Kit Mk2. It also takes a second speed card now.
advancements.robotica.guide.warp.title: Home Run
advancements.robotica.guide.warp.descrip: Place two Warp Pads, power them, stand on one and right-click it.
advancements.robotica.guide.diamonds.des: Find diamonds. They make the Excavator and the Age 2 parts.
advancements.robotica.guide.excavator.de: Place an Excavator with a chest next to it. It digs a hole down to bedrock, slowly, unless you feed it speed cards and power.
advancements.robotica.guide.age2.title: Servo Age
advancements.robotica.guide.age2.descrip: Craft an Advanced Circuit or a Reinforced Casing: diamonds, obsidian and quartz.
advancements.robotica.guide.servo_core.d: Get a Servo Core. It upgrades your Bore Drill and builds the Mob Replicator.
Smith your Bore Drill into a Servo Drill: 5x5 and vein mining.
advancements.robotica.guide.vial.title: Sample Size
advancements.robotica.guide.vial.descrip: Right-click the same kind of monster eight times with an Essence Vial.
advancements.robotica.guide.replicator.d: Build the 3x3x3 Mob Replicator around an empty centre, with at least one Replicator Glass.
advancements.robotica.guide.age3.title: Deep Age
advancements.robotica.guide.age3.descrip: Craft a Quantum Circuit: blaze rods and netherite from the Nether.
advancements.robotica.guide.magma_core.d: Get a Magma Core: Magma Drill, Arc Blade, Rift Upgrade and Age 3 mobs in the replicator.
Smith a Magma Drill. Turn on auto-smelt in its settings.
advancements.robotica.guide.age4.title: Antigrav Age
advancements.robotica.guide.age4.descrip: Craft a Null Circuit: ender pearls and a nether star.
advancements.robotica.guide.antigrav_cor: Get an Antigrav Core: the Null Drill, the Null Lance and Portal Projectors.
advancements.robotica.guide.null_drill.d: Smith a Null Drill and dig a 12x12x12 cube in one swing.
advancements.robotica.guide.portal.title: Through the Lens
advancements.robotica.guide.portal.descr: Link two Portal Projectors with a Linking Card and step through the portal.
